rows.name:
One of the wind turbines was attacked by Hodes.[XENO:n ]
Help resolve the Ether Plant problem.
Teach the head of the Hodes a lesson.

Use the Turbine Access Panel in the[XENO:n ]
Ether Plant at Eryth Sea to fix the plant.
Return to Jack.

The Ether Plant is working again. Now Jack[XENO:n ]
should be able to fix the lighthouse.

Find the Hode Refuge and teach the Hode leader[XENO:n ]
a lesson.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Funeral Gozra[/System:Color] at the Hode Refuge in[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.

You have defeated the Hode leader and ensured[XENO:n ]
the safety of the wind turbine.
Fix the wind turbine that the Hodes broke.

Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Luxury Hode Wood[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
Hodes at Eryth Sea.
Return to Jack.

Use the Turbine Access Panel in the[XENO:n ]
Ether Plant at Eryth Sea to fix the plant.
Return to Jack.

The wind turbine has been fixed with the[XENO:n ]
materials you collected and is working fine now.
Cronies of the defeated Hode leader want revenge.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Confusion Ekidnos[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.
Return to Jack.

You defeated the cronies of the Hode leader so[XENO:n ]
the Ether Plant should be safe...finally!

There are more problems with the lighthouse. The[XENO:n ]
light won't come on. When darkness falls, monsters[XENO:n ]
will attack. Defend the lighthouse.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Decay Ekidnos[/System:Color] near Syrath Lighthouse[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea. (Only at night.)
Return to Sherren.

The lighthouse is safe and has been fixed. Now[XENO:n ]
it lights up the whole area.

Milia tried to stop Talia but Talia didn't listen and[XENO:n ]
went off to Satorl all alone. Talia could be in grave[XENO:n ]
danger. Go and help her.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Dogmatic Gogol[/System:Color] near the[XENO:n ]
Place of Judgement in Satorl Marsh.

Talk to Talia who is at the Place of Judgement[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Talk to Talia who is on the Ether Plant[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea.

Talia wanted to complete the research into[XENO:n ]
the War God faith for her lost friends.

It seems that there is a statue of the War God in Valak[XENO:n ]
Mountain. Complete the research into the War God[XENO:n ]
faith for Russ and Natori.

Investigate the War God statue at La Luz Church[XENO:n ]
in Valak Mountain.
Talk to Talia.

The birthplace of the War God faith must be[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain. Their research is complete.

Milia fled the capital with Tet, but at some point[XENO:n ]
seems to have lost sight of him. Find Tet to ease[XENO:n ]
her worried heart.
Talk to Tet.
Return to Milia.

Tet was hiding in the imperial capital. You[XENO:n ]
rescued him, and put Milia's worries to rest.

When Vivian fled the imperial capital, she was helped[XENO:n ]
by Telethia. She feels it must be some good friends.[XENO:n ]
Try and find out if this is the truth.
Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]Arel Telethia[/System:Color] in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Arietta[/System:Color] near the Fountain of[XENO:n ]
Eternity in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Louise[/System:Color] near Melfica Road[XENO:n ]
in Achamoth.
Return to Vivian.

It really was Vivian's friends who saved her.[XENO:n ]
Vivian offers up a tearful prayer for her friends.

When Vivian was fleeing the Imperial City, she was[XENO:n ]
saved by some Telethia who turned out to be her[XENO:n ]
friends. It will be sad, but you should put them to rest.
Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]Arel Telethia[/System:Color] in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Arietta[/System:Color] near the Fountain of[XENO:n ]
Eternity in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Louise[/System:Color] near Melfica Road[XENO:n ]
in Achamoth.
Return to Vivian.

Vivian's two friends are at peace now.[XENO:n ]
Vivian offers up a tearful prayer for her friends.

There is a Telethia research facility within the[XENO:n ]
High Entia Tomb. Go to the High Entia Tomb and[XENO:n ]
find the research facility.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Research[/System:Color] from the Telethia[XENO:n ]
Laboratory in the High Entia Tomb
Return to Tet.

You found the Telethia Research. Perhaps the[XENO:n ]
Telethia will return to their original forms one day.

There are lots of monsters at Eryth Sea.[XENO:n ]
Clear some so it's safer.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Palti Kromars[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the lighthouse keeper's request.[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea should be a little safer now.

There are lots of monsters at Eryth Sea.[XENO:n ]
Clear some so it's safer.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Maleza Kromars[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the lighthouse keeper's request.[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea should be a little safer now.

Eryth Sea is very dangerous. There is a particularly[XENO:n ]
terrifying monster that should be exterminated.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Flabbergasted Jerome[/System:Color] in the area of[XENO:n ]
Hovering Reef 5 at Eryth Sea.

You completed the lighthouse keeper's request.[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea should be a little safer now.

The Achamoth resident wants to research Eryth Sea[XENO:n ]
but she can't find the things she needs. Collect some[XENO:n ]
items and materials for her.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Hiln Coin Purses[/System:Color] from Eryth Hilns in[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Doomsday Poppies[/System:Color] from Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Now she should be able to start her investigation.

The Achamoth resident wants to research Eryth Sea[XENO:n ]
but she can't find the things she needs. Collect some[XENO:n ]
items and materials for her.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Andos Antennae[/System:Color] from Andos in the[XENO:n ]
High Entia Tomb.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Old Dragon Spines[/System:Color] from Racti Lexos at[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.
Collect 3 spears of [System:Color name=item ]Pink Asparagus[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Now she should be able to start her investigation.

There has been a support request from a worker who[XENO:n ]
is fixing a transporter near Syrath Lighthouse at Eryth[XENO:n ]
Sea. He may be in danger. Hurry to help him!

Go to Hovering Reef 4 where Syrath Lighthouse[XENO:n ]
is situated and ask where the worker is.

Go from the back of Syrath Lighthouse to the[XENO:n ]
Ether Crystal Deposit.

Help the worker that is being attacked[XENO:n ]
by Kromars.
Talk to the worker.

You saved the worker. Now he should be able[XENO:n ]
to continue repairing the transporter.

Prison Island is accessible via a transporter from[XENO:n ]
Central Seal Island. Open the sister gates, Khatorl and[XENO:n ]
Soltnar which protect it to open the transporter's seal.
Open the sister gates Khatorl and Soltnar.

Unlock the seal that has appeared to be able[XENO:n ]
to reach Prison Island.

The transporter's seal has been broken. You[XENO:n ]
can now go to Prison Island.

To open the gates that protect the transporter to[XENO:n ]
Prison Island, you will need to release the seals on[XENO:n ]
Khatorl Seal Island and Soltnar Seal Island.
Release the seal on Khatorl Seal Island.
Release the seal on Soltnar Seal Island.
The Khatorl and Soltnar gates are open.
